payload.name: Preserve Prior Facts When Enriching Memories
payload.description: Use when updating or merging an existing memory with new messages that add details about the same subject, to ensure previously stored explicit facts are retained.
content: During CRUD (UPDATE/MERGE), compare any proposed new memory content against the existing version it targets before writing.

Retain every explicit fact already stored in the existing memory unless a new message directly contradicts it; add newly stated details as additional facets rather than replacing the old content with a narrower paraphrase.
Stop after consolidating the preserved facts with the new explicit details; do not infer or add unrelated attributes.

solves: When the Construction Agent enriches an existing memory with new conversation details, it sometimes rewrites the memory as a narrower summary and drops explicit facts stored earlier, making those facts unavailable for later questions. This skill ensures that UPDATE and MERGE operations preserve prior explicit attributes while adding new ones.
